blocks.plainText: In C4, C6, C7, C8, M1, M2 or M3 Districts, for public parking garages with more than 150 spaces, the City Planning Commission may permit modifications of the applicable regulations in Sections 33-26 to 33-30, inclusive, and Sections 43-26 to 43-31, inclusive, relative to rear yard regulations, provided the following findings are made:

blocks.html: (a)        that the public parking garage will alleviate excessive on-street parking demand and thereby relieve traffic congestion in the area; and

blocks.html: (b)        that because of site limitations such modification is necessary for the proper design and operation of the public parking garage.
